KINGROON will be exhibiting at Formnext 2025, showcasing our latest innovations in high-performance 3D printing materials and solutions. From advanced PLA, PETG, TPU, and Silk filaments to carbon fiber reinforced materials, we are committed to delivering reliable, high-quality printing experiences for makers, professionals, and industrial applications worldwide.
We’re proud to deliver exceptional products and service to every customer we serve.
Tried the Kingroon PLA and wow… my printer basically turned into a little factory. Zero drama, just smooth prints. My cat’s new toy? 100% approved. 🐾😂
Printing with Kingroon PETG feels like giving my projects superpowers. Strong, shiny, and not a single crack. My coffee mug holder survived a week already… miracles happen. ☕💪
The spool is wound neatly, the diameter is consistent, and I haven’t had any tangling. I can actually walk away from my printer without worrying, because I trust this filament to run smoothly.
I’ve gone through a couple spools now and every single one has been consistent. No weird issues, no bad batches. Just solid, reliable printing every time. That’s why I keep coming back.

As someone who’s not a pro at 3D printing, I love how easy this filament is to work with. It sticks to the bed without issues, no warping, and the layers look smooth. Honestly takes a lot of stress out of printing.

The colors on this filament are so bright and vibrant! What you see on the spool is exactly what you get on your prints. My models have never looked this good, and I’ve already had friends asking where I got the filament.
I’ve been printing a few functional parts with this, and they turned out surprisingly strong and durable. Not just for decorative stuff—this filament can actually handle some real use.
